description: This file contains functions and types for converting diffs of board/card elements into Slack attachments, including template management for notifications, handling card modifications, additions, deletions, and related content changes.

classes.name: DiffConvOpts
classes.description: Options for converting diffs to Slack attachments, including language, link generation functions, and logger.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached template based on name and language, with default functions for link and author formatting.

methods.name: makeAuthorsList
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated list of authors' usernames, prefixed with '@'.

methods.name: execTemplate
methods.description: Executes a named template with provided data, writing output to an io.Writer.

methods.name: Diffs2SlackAttachments
methods.description: Converts a list of diffs into Slack attachments for notification purposes.

methods.name: cardDiff2SlackAttachment
methods.description: Creates a Slack attachment from a card diff, handling add, delete, and modify scenarios, including content and property changes.

methods.name: appendTitleChanges
methods.description: Appends title change information to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendPropertyChanges
methods.description: Appends property change details to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendCommentChanges
methods.description: Appends comment addition or deletion details to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendAttachmentChanges
methods.description: Appends attachment add/delete information to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendContentChanges
methods.description: Appends content/description change details to Slack attachment fields, including markdown diff generation.
